sources.kind: publication supplementary table 8, sheet TMT cell lines

claims.location: source name, characteristics[biological replicate], characteristics[genotype], factor value[genotype]
claims.value: 14 independently labelled Hoxb8-immortalized mouse bone marrow clone samples and one pooled reference
claims.evidence: Supplementary methods describe generation of Hoxb8-immortalized primary murine bone marrow cell lines and independent clones as biological replicates. Supplementary Table 8 names WT1/WT2/WT6, Ex38/Ex59/Ex61, A5/B8/C10/D2 and corresponding Ex clones, plus mix; it gives four genotype groups and the pooled reference. Matching A5/B8/C10/D2 clone IDs retain biological replicate numbers across fl/+ and -/+ states.

claims.location: characteristics[organism], characteristics[organism part], characteristics[material type], characteristics[cell line], characteristics[cell line model], characteristics[sampling site], characteristics[culture medium details], characteristics[cellosaurus accession]
claims.value: Mus musculus; not applicable; cell line; generic cell line; Hoxb8-immortalized mouse bone marrow-derived cell line; bone marrow; Iscove's modified Dulbecco's medium (IMDM); not available
claims.evidence: Supplementary methods state primary murine bone marrow cells were immortalized with ERHBD-Hoxb8 and expanded as independent cell clones in IMDM. The measured material is cultured cell line, not an organ specimen; bone marrow is the sampling site of the original cells. No accession for these study-generated clones is given; the generic controlled cell-line ontology class is paired with a source-grounded free-text cell-line-model field rather than inventing a registered identity. Exact IMDM is recorded in a free-text culture-medium-details field because the NCIT-constrained culture-medium field has no matching term in the validator cache.

claims.value: 15 used TMTpro channels from TMT126 through TMT133C; TMT134N unused
claims.evidence: Supplementary Table 8 explicitly maps each clone and pooled mix to its reporter label. MaxQuant isobaricLabels include the same 15 channels and omit 134N. The unused channel has no SDRF rows.

claims.location: comment[data file], comment[fraction identifier], comment[technical replicate]
claims.value: 24 RAW files, two technical workflow replicates of 12 fractions each
claims.evidence: The accession-scoped PRIDE file list contains 24 phospho RAW files with complete R1 and R2 fraction series 1-12. Deposited MaxQuant experiment and file lists assign exactly these RAW files to the corresponding phospho search. Supplementary methods explicitly state two workflow replicates and 12 fractions.

claims.location: comment[instrument], comment[proteomics data acquisition method], comment[dissociation method]
claims.evidence: Supplementary methods mass spectrometry section states Evosep One coupled to Orbitrap Exploris 480, Top10 data-dependent acquisition, and HCD fragmentation.

claims.location: comment[cleavage agent details], comment[digestion enzymes], comment[modification parameters], comment[precursor mass tolerance], comment[fragment mass tolerance]
claims.value: Trypsin; Lys-C and trypsin co-digest; MaxQuant fixed and variable modifications; 4.5 ppm final precursor tolerance; 20 ppm FTMS fragment tolerance
claims.evidence: Supplementary methods state both Lys-C and trypsin were used for digestion. The single controlled cleavage-agent field names trypsin, and a free-text assay comment preserves the two-enzyme co-digest. Deposited MaxQuant mqpar.xml lists the Trypsin/P search rule, carbamidomethyl C fixed, oxidation M, protein N-terminal acetyl, deamidation N/Q and TMTpro K and peptide N-terminal fixed. The phosphoproteome search additionally includes phosphorylation S/T/Y. Its final search tolerance is 4.5 ppm and FTMS MS/MS tolerance is 20 ppm. Supplementary methods describe initial 20 ppm precursor and 0.5 Da initial fragment tolerances; deposited final settings are used for the SDRF.
Supplementary methods sample preparation section states lysis buffer with 5 mM TCEP and 10 mM chloroacetamide.

limitations: These study-created Hoxb8 clones have no reported Cellosaurus accession, passage count, donor age/sex, or mouse strain; those details are not inferred.
The pooled reference is identified as mix from 14 individual samples; its genotype is not applicable.

The paper describes Lys-C plus trypsin digestion, while the deposited MaxQuant search enzyme rule is Trypsin/P; the wet-lab co-digest is recorded in a custom assay comment because the controlled cleavage-agent field is single-valued.
The deposited search config covers 15 used TMTpro reporter channels; no sample is assigned to TMT134N.
